latest.description: While exploring some of the latest AWS security updates, I came across a feature that caught my attention: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities.

latest.title: From Zero to AI App: A Beginner’s Roadmap to Building with AWS
latest.description: Want to build your first AI-powered application but don't know where to start? Explore a beginner-friendly roadmap to combining cloud computing, generative AI, and practical development skills using AWS.

latest.title: Adding Guardrails to an Amazon Bedrock App
latest.description: Learn how to add Amazon Bedrock Guardrails to your app. Create a guardrail with content filters, a denied topic, and personal data protection, attach it to a Converse call in Python, and test it with a repeatable set of prompts.

latest.title: My First 3 AWS Services Every Beginner Should Learn
latest.description: I started my cloud journey 15 days ago on AWS Builder Center. As a beginner, I was confused with so many services.

latest.title: Your AWS Architecture Is Only as Strong as Its Weakest Link: 7 Lessons Every Cloud Engineer Should Know
latest.description: Explore seven essential lessons for building stronger AWS architectures. Learn how cloud engineers approach high availability, security, observability, cost optimization, serverless applications, Infrastructure as Code, and disaster recovery. Discover practical AWS best practices, understand common architectural challenges, and learn to design cloud systems that are more secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient.

latest.title: How to Host a Static Website on Amazon S3: A Beginner-Friendly Guide
latest.description: Learn how to host a static website on Amazon S3 using AWS. This step-by-step guide covers S3 bucket creation, static website hosting configuration, permissions, deployment, and testing your website.

latest.title: AWS Says Everything Is Healthy. So Why Is Your App Broken?
latest.description: Is your application failing even though AWS resources appear healthy? Learn a practical troubleshooting workflow using Amazon CloudWatch, application logs, API status codes, database connectivity, metrics, and timeouts to identify and fix common cloud application failures.

latest.title: AWS Cost Alert and Automatic Resource Cleanup: A Smarter Way to Manage Cloud Costs
latest.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a wide range of cloud services that help developers, students, startups, and businesses build and deploy applications. However, managing cloud costs can be challenging, especially for beginners who are still learning how different AWS services work.

trending.description: A recap of my talk on ten years of Apache SkyWalking, Horizon’s visual infrastructure views, and ASZ replay for Claude Code, LangChain/LangGraph, and Kiro.

trending.title: 无侵入监控和回放 Claude Code 会话执行过程
trending.description: Apache SkyWalking AI Sessionizer 可以直接读取本机已有的 Claude Code 记录，将对话、工具调用和子 Agent 的执行过程关联起来，在浏览器中查看。接入时不需要在 Claude Code 中安装插件或修改配置，使用 Sessionizer 之前留下的历史记录也可以回放。

trending.title: What Is a REST API? Build a Dad Joke API on AWS in 5 Minutes"
trending.description: Learn what a REST API is (resources, HTTP methods, status codes, and stateless requests), then build and deploy a dad joke API with Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and AWS SAM.

trending.title: New AWS Sign-up Experience - No Credit Card Required
trending.description: Experience much easier and faster sign up for AWS that enables you to start building quickly by using an existing sign-in method like Google, Apple, GitHub, and Amazon accounts. Get started immediately with preconfigured defaults, use projects to organize what you build, score up to $200 in free AWS credits, and transition to an Enterprise account when you need to.

trending.title: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618): How AI Found a Decade-Old Bug in 70% of the Web
trending.description: Two critical pre-authentication RCE flaws in PHP (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619), uncovered by AI models, sparked a global patching scramble across 70% of the web.

trending.title: Vibe coding is not a delivery process
trending.description: A coding agent can ship a feature fast, but someone still has to explain it, verify it and own it in production. Building on my chalk talk at AWS Community Day Rome, I argue that vibe coding isn’t enough: teams need to own their delivery process. That means every decision has an owner, releases go out only on evidence for the exact change, and agents can’t touch their own checks. Autonomy is granted one action at a time, and Kiro and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore support every phase.

trending.title: AWS IAM Hands-On Lab: Users, Groups & Permissions Explained
trending.description: Learn AWS IAM through a hands-on lab with 3 users, 3 groups, and real S3 and EC2 permission tests. Understand policies, access control, and least privilege.

trending.title: Cómo Preparar y Aprobar el AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) en 7 Días
trending.description: La inteligencia artificial generativa y el aprendizaje automático están transformando la arquitectura de software moderna a una velocidad sin precedentes.

trending.title: Meet Grid Dodger: An Arcade Game Built With Strands Decider 2B
trending.description:
What happens when you give a small decision model the controls to an arcade game?
I built Grid Dodger to find out. A ship moves across five lanes while asteroids and enemy fighters fall toward it. The model gets three choices: left, stay, or right. The goal is to reach 500 points, with difficulty rising from 100.

trending.title: Rent the Cores, Keep the Phone: Building LineageOS 24 on EC2 and Iterating at Home
trending.description: A full LineageOS 24.0 build outgrows a 32 GB home machine. A 192-core EC2 instance runs the long build, the 266 GB tree comes home at the same path, and the home machine packages the zip next to the phone. Claude Code drives both ends.
